item.title: Version 0.1.25
item.description: Self-healing history: RunBar now refetches the last 12 weeks from Strava daily and repairs every weekly total — weeks where your Mac was off no longer leave holes, and totals stuck on partial sums are corrected. Sunday-start weeks are respected everywhere (sparkline, streak, week numbers). New recovery mode: after a big week the runner takes an earned breather. Past weeks read better, honest percentages above 100%.
